You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then help you transfer those prescriptions. Great, Jamal. Now let me pull up your prescriptions and find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. I'm not finding any active prescriptions under your name in our system, and I'm also not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you double-check the store location or address? That way I can make sure we're sending them to the right place.  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, find_stores]
CALLER: I don't know the address, I just moved. Can't you just tell me which ones there are?
AGENT: I can help you find Harbor stores, but I need a bit more to go on. Do you know what city or area you moved to, or any cross streets near the new location?
CALLER: Near Oak.
AGENT: Let me search for Harbor stores near Oak. I found two Harbor stores near Oak: one at 410 Oak Street in Brookfield, Connecticut, and one at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, Michigan near Oak Street. Is one of those your new location?  [system actions: find_stores]
CALLER: Yeah, the one in Lakeview, Michigan, near Oak Street. That's the one by my apartment.
AGENT (LATEST): Perfect. Before I transfer your prescriptions, I need to let you know that I'm not finding any active prescriptions for albuterol or sertraline in our system right now. Are those prescriptions currently at the Brightway in Columbus, or is it possible they're somewhere else?

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent first asks which Main St store he means without offering options
stop_0: Agent confirms both transfers to H-302 with its address.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent offered specific store options, not open-ended ask."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No transfer confirmation occurred; no prescriptions found."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
